edits.before: 这时的国会人很少。同一天，日志记下一个付诸表决的问题：七个州出席的国会，是否有权接受总司令的辞职？日志留下了点名表决：在本篇所见的部分名单中，除帕特里奇投了反对外，其余议员均为赞成；其中埃勒里的反对票，日志记为“应该议员请求”改成了赞成。这段摘录没有显示表决结果。22日的出席记录是马萨诸塞、罗得岛、宾夕法尼亚、特拉华、马里兰、弗吉尼亚和北卡罗来纳七个州，另有新罕布什尔和南卡罗来纳各一名议员。到了23日接见当天，国会还议决立即写信给新罕布什尔、康涅狄格、纽约、新泽西、南卡罗来纳和佐治亚六个州的行政长官，催他们的代表马上到会：国会在此开会期间，出席的从未超过七个州，其中多数只有两名代表，而批准正式和约等几件要务都需要至少九个州同意。
edits.after: 这时的国会人很少：出席的只有七个州。同一天，即12月20日，日志记下一个付诸表决的问题：七个州出席的国会，是否有权接受总司令的辞职？而据国会23日的议决，批准正式和约等几件要务都需要至少九个州同意。具体情形如下。22日的出席记录是马萨诸塞、罗得岛、宾夕法尼亚、特拉华、马里兰、弗吉尼亚和北卡罗来纳七个州，另有新罕布什尔和南卡罗来纳各一名议员。20日那次表决留下了点名记录：在本篇所见的部分名单中，除帕特里奇投了反对外，其余议员均为赞成；其中埃勒里的反对票，日志记为“应该议员请求”改成了赞成。这段摘录没有显示表决结果。到了23日接见当天，国会议决立即写信给新罕布什尔、康涅狄格、纽约、新泽西、南卡罗来纳和佐治亚六个州的行政长官，催他们的代表马上到会，理由是：国会在此开会期间，出席的从未超过七个州，其中多数只有两名代表。

edits.before: Congress was thin at the time. The same day, the journal records a question put to the vote: "Is it the sense of Congress that seven states in Congress Assembled are competent to receive the resignation of a Commander in Chief?" The journal kept the roll call. In the portion of the roll call cited here, every member voted ay except Partridge, who voted no; Ellery's no was recorded as "changed into ay at the request of the Member". This excerpt does not show the result of the vote. On the 22nd the states present were Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, Virginia and North Carolina, with one member each from New Hampshire and South Carolina. And on the day of the audience itself, the 23rd, Congress resolved to write at once to the executives of New Hampshire, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, South Carolina and Georgia, demanding the immediate attendance of their delegates: during the sitting at this place there had never been more than seven states represented, most of them by only two delegates, and the ratification of the definitive treaty, among other matters, required the assent of at least nine states.
edits.after: Congress was thin at the time: only seven states were present. The same day, 20 December, the journal records a question put to the vote: "Is it the sense of Congress that seven states in Congress Assembled are competent to receive the resignation of a Commander in Chief?" And, as Congress itself resolved on the 23rd, the ratification of the definitive treaty, among other matters, required the assent of at least nine states. The details follow. On the 22nd the states present were Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, Virginia and North Carolina, with one member each from New Hampshire and South Carolina. The 20 December vote left a roll call. In the portion of the roll call cited here, every member voted ay except Partridge, who voted no; Ellery's no was recorded as "changed into ay at the request of the Member". This excerpt does not show the result of the vote. On the day of the audience itself, the 23rd, Congress resolved to write at once to the executives of New Hampshire, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, South Carolina and Georgia, demanding the immediate attendance of their delegates, on the ground that during the sitting at this place there had never been more than seven states represented, most of them by only two delegates.

edits.before: 一种解释是，国会把这场交接的性质先写进了姿态里：讲话的人起身、鞠躬、陈述、退出，听取的人自始至终坐着，只把帽子摘一下。权力不是在讲话文本里才交还的，在鞠躬与脱帽的不对称里已经交还了一半。这是作者的解释；日志只记规则，不写理由。

edits.before: One reading of this is that Congress wrote the nature of the transaction into posture before a word was spoken. The speaker rises, bows, gives his account, and withdraws; the listeners remain seated throughout and do no more than lift a hat. Power is not returned only in the text of a speech; half of it is already returned in the asymmetry between the bow and the uncovered head. That is the author's reading. The journal records the rules and gives no reasons.

Ceremony, prescribed posture, and token together make up this transfer of power; as for posture, what the journal records is the rule, not how it was carried out.

Both the draft protocol of the order of audience and the printed text of Congress's answer carry brackets or revision marks: the bracketed words in the draft protocol are in Boudinot's writing, according to the editors' note, while the answer is, according to the editors' note, a report in McHenry's writing, its bracketed portion entered in the Journal by Bankson; Congress's answer is quoted here only in clean stretches; the material was captured by OCR (archive.org) from the 1922 printed volume and contains misreadings, so quotations take only clean stretches; in the draft protocol, the OCR text this piece relies on confirms only the bracketed words, and any other deletions or revisions cannot be determined.

issues.problem: 小标题“这份记录没有告诉我们的／What This Record Does Not Tell Us”断言了完整来源没写什么。本节正文其实是在说明本篇的依据范围（未查阅私人记述），不是在说日志本身缺载什么。

evidence.quote: MONDAY, DECEMBER 22, 1783

issues.proposed: 改为“六、本篇依据的范围”／“VI. The Limits of This Piece's Sources”。

issues.problem: “1783年12月20日的来信／the letter … of December 20”容易被读成信写于20日。证据只表明信在20日当天被宣读，没有给出写信日期。

evidence.quote: from the Commander in Chief, was read, informing Congress of his arrival in this city

issues.proposed: 改为“12月20日宣读的来信”／“the letter read on December 20”。

issues.problem: 开头第二段在点出难处（只有七州出席、需九州同意）之后，紧接着堆了两串州名和点名表决细节。读者此时还用不上这些信息，核心问题因此被冲淡。

evidence.quote: Present, Massachusetts, Rhode Island , Pensylvania, Delaware, Maryland, Virginia and North Carolina

issues.proposed: 保留“七州出席、就七州是否有权表决、要务需九州”三句。“具体情形如下”之后的州名清单和点名细节移到后文或注释，内容不删。

issues.problem: 长括注集中讨论议定稿方括号和OCR乱码，打断了解释段的主线。这部分内容与 context.3、limits.1 也有重复。

evidence.quote: copy of his address to hia aid to be pre acntod to the Scorotaiy [to the President]

issues.proposed: 括注压缩为一句“议定稿此处的改动见上文与第六节”，技术细节留在 limits.1。

verify.overall: 定稿史实、引语、归属与中英文对应都有证据支持，解释段也已标明是作者的解释。需修改两处：limits 小标题改成本篇依据范围的表述，uncertainty_note 中来信日期的写法改为“20日宣读”；另有两处易读性建议。

issues.problem: 开头第一句称“大陆会议”，同一句后半和全文都改称“国会”。两者是同一机构，但文中没有说明，读者可能以为是两个机构。

evidence.quote: the President and members are to be seated and covered

issues.proposed: 首次出现时写作“大陆会议（以下简称国会）”，英文写作“the Continental Congress (Congress for short)”，此后统一称“国会”。

issues.problem: 证据U-E21补全了点名记录：福斯特、格里、奥斯古德也投了赞成，全部点名中只有帕特里奇投反对。稿件仍写“本篇所见的部分名单”，低估了证据。“这段摘录没有显示表决结果”是关于来源没写什么的断言，读者理解用不上；完整点名已能说明票数分布。该段的证据列表也没有列入U-E21。

evidence.quote: Mf Forster, ay Gerry, ay Osgood, ay
Partridge, no Ellery, no changed into ay at the request of the Member

issues.proposed: 中文改为“点名记录中只有帕特里奇投了反对；埃勒里原投反对，日志记为应本人请求改为赞成”，英文对应改为“In the roll call, Partridge alone voted no; …”。删去“这段摘录没有显示表决结果／This excerpt does not show the result of the vote”，并在证据列表中补入U-E21。

issues.problem: 开头第二段在说清难点（只有七州出席、需要表决“七州是否有权接受辞职”、要务需九州同意）之后，紧接着堆入七州州名、议员姓名、改票细节和六个缺席州的名单。不了解背景的读者暂时用不上这些细节，反而会被淹没。

evidence.quote: seven states in Congress Assembled are competent to receive the resignation of a Commander in Chief?
the assent of at least nine states is necessary

issues.proposed: 本段只保留核心：七州出席、关于七州权限的表决、和约等要务需九州同意、23日写信催缺席州到会。具体州名、点名细节和缺席州名单移到后文或局限部分，内容不删。

issues.problem: 格里、博迪诺首次出现时没有说明身份。证据只说明了他们的笔迹归属，读者可能以为两人在故事中另有作用。

evidence.quote: This report, in the writing of Elbridge Gerry, the words in brackets being in the writing of Elias Boudinot

issues.proposed: 写明他们仅以笔迹归属出现，例如“编者注把这份报告的笔迹归于埃尔布里奇·格里，方括号里的字归于埃利亚斯·博迪诺”。不要补写证据中没有的身份。

issues.problem: “据编者注”同时管到“印本文字带修改痕迹”。编者注（U-E23）只说明这份报告是麦克亨利的笔迹；修改痕迹是从印本文字本身看出来的，不是编者注说的。

evidence.quote: Thia report, in the writing of James McHenry, is in the Papers of the Continental Congress
The portion in brackets was entered in the Journal by Benjamin Bankson.

issues.proposed: 改为：据编者注，这份答词是詹姆斯·麦克亨利笔迹的报告，方括号部分由本杰明·班克森录入日志；印本文字本身可见修改痕迹。英文同步调整。

verify.overall: 定稿史实、引文和解释标注总体可靠。需修正四处：点名记录的表述和一句来源未载断言（context.1），开头的机构称谓和信息堆积，以及局限部分一处归属；完成后可发。

issues.problem: 开头第二段堆了完整州名清单、逐人点名细节（帕特里奇、埃勒里改票）和两份州名单。这些是读者还用不上的信息，会淹没要点：当时只有七州出席，国会为此专门表决“七州是否有权接受辞职”，而要务需要九州。

evidence.quote: seven states in Congress Assembled are competent to receive the resignation of a Commander in Chief?
there have not been, during the sitting of Congress at this place, more than seven states represented
the assent of at least nine states is necessary

issues.proposed: 本段先用一两句交代：当时出席的只有七个州，国会就“七州是否有权接受总司令辞职”专门表决；而批准和约等要务至少需要九个州。点名细节（帕特里奇反对、埃勒里改票、本篇所见名单不全）和两份完整州名单移到段末或后文，内容不删。

issues.problem: 同一机构首句称“大陆会议”，句末改称“国会”，全篇此后都用“国会”。读者可能以为是两个机构。英文 Continental Congress 与 Congress 也是同样情况。
issues.proposed: 首次出现写作“大陆会议（下称国会）”；英文写作 the Continental Congress (hereafter Congress)。

issues.problem: “日志只记规则，不写理由”/“The journal records the rules and gives no reasons”是在断言完整来源没写什么。本篇只依据证据摘录，前文已标明“这是作者的解释”，这半句读者理解不需要。
issues.proposed: 删去“日志只记规则，不写理由”/“The journal records the rules and gives no reasons.”，保留“这是作者的解释”。

issues.problem: “说这话时是什么语气，日志无从体现，本篇也不猜”/“What tone his voice carried is beyond the reach of the journal”是关于完整来源的否定断言，读者理解不需要。
issues.proposed: 删去这半句，止于“这是他自己的说法”/“those are his own words.”

issues.problem: “日志本身并未陈述其用意”/“the journal itself states no such intention”断言完整来源没写什么，无从核实。解释标签前文已有。
issues.proposed: 改为“这是作者对记录方式的解释。”/“That is the author's interpretation of how the record was made.”，删去关于日志未陈述用意的半句。

issues.problem: “关于姿态，日志记下的是规定，而不是执行情况”断言日志没有记录执行情况。证据中23日的记录其实记了部分执行（就座、宣布肃静）。这句应改为本文依据范围内的说法。

evidence.quote: being seated, and silence ordered
he is to bow to Congress, which they are to return by uncovering without bowing

issues.proposed: 改为“关于鞠躬与脱帽，本篇依据的是22日议定的规定”/“as for bowing and uncovering, this piece relies on the rule agreed on the 22nd”。

issues.problem: 英文“Congress wanted those present to see...”独立成句，读起来像在陈述国会的动机这一事实。中文在“一种解释是”之后的同一句中，标签清楚。
issues.proposed: 英文改为“On this reading, Congress wanted those present to see...”。

issues.problem: “日志只写了戴帽与就座，没写为什么”/“The journal notes covering and seating, and no more”断言完整来源没写理由，无从核实。

evidence.quote: The President and members are to be seated and covered

issues.proposed: 删去该半句，保留“这条解释是作者提出的”/“That explanation is the author's.”

issues.problem: “日志没有把这几件事联系起来”/“The journal does not connect these things”断言完整来源未作联系，无从核实。
issues.proposed: 改为“这几件事的联系是作者的推断”/“the connection between these things is the author's inference.”

issues.problem: “日志记动作、记次序、记讲话，不描写个人的神情与现场反应”/“it does not describe individual faces or reactions in the room”断言完整日志没写什么；“凡是原文没写的……”/“where the source is silent”也属同类断言。前一句“本篇未取得在场者私人记述”已足以说明限度。
issues.proposed: 删去“日志记动作……不描写……现场反应”一句；末句改为“本篇不推测他的动机、念头或考虑过的选项”/“This piece does not supply his motives, private thoughts, or options he may have considered.”

issues.problem: 关于国会答词，第一条保留只说“只引用OCR清晰片段”，遗漏了证据中的两点：日志所印答词是麦克亨利笔迹的草稿，带修改痕迹；答词中方括号部分由班克森录入日志。第三条保留也只把方括号改动归于接见次序议定稿。story.6 把答词当作国会所说直接引用，读者无从知道引文出自带修改的草稿。

evidence.quote: Thia report, in the writing of James McHenry, is in the Papers of the Continental Congress, No. 19, VI, folio 461.
The portion in brackets was entered in the Journal by Benjamin Bankson.

issues.proposed: 第一条补入：据编者注，日志所印答词是詹姆斯·麦克亨利笔迹的报告，文字带修改痕迹，方括号部分由本杰明·班克森录入日志；本篇只引用其中OCR清晰、未见改动的片段。英文同步。

issues.problem: “没有在场者私人记述可对照，个人神情与现场反应不可知”/“No private account by anyone present was available... unknowable”断言这类记述不存在、现场情形不可知，无法核实。证据只能说明本篇没有查阅。
issues.proposed: 中文改为“本篇未查阅在场者私人记述，个人神情与现场反应本篇无从得知”；英文改为“No private account by anyone present was consulted, so this piece cannot report individual faces or reactions.”

issues.problem: “带括号改动的是接见次序的议定稿”/“the draft bearing bracketed changes is the protocol”暗示只有议定稿带改动。证据显示国会答词也带方括号部分和修改痕迹（麦克亨利草稿）。

evidence.quote: The portion in brackets was entered in the Journal by Benjamin Bankson.
in the writing of James McHenry

issues.proposed: 改为：接见次序议定稿与国会答词的印本都带方括号或修改痕迹；议定稿方括号字样据编者注为博迪诺笔迹，答词为麦克亨利笔迹的报告、方括号部分由班克森录入。英文同步。

inherited.rationale: 英文句子断言在场者私人记述不存在、现场反应不可知，无法核实；应改为本篇未查阅。与 F12 相同。
中文对应句子存在同一问题，F12 已一并处理中英两版。
U-E22 只记录这次表决以点名方式进行，与正文“这段摘录没有显示表决结果”不冲突。U-E23 显示日志所印答词是麦克亨利笔迹的草稿、带修改痕迹，正文的保留部分未交代这一点，见 F11 与 F13。

evidence.quote: with yeaa and nays, December 20, 1783.
in the writing of James McHenry
